_comment: The measured truth about the physical rig. Everything reads this. All values null until they are measured. Bump version and re-measure whenever the rig physically changes: different guitar, exciter moved, amp gain touched, interface settings changed. Version 0 means nothing has been measured yet.
_platform_note: Moved from Bela to a Mac host on 2026-09-06 because the Bela is not connectable. See docs/ground-rules-and-facts.md 3.3 and docs/mac-rig-plan.md. The parked Bela profile shape is preserved under 'bela_parked'.

host._channel_index_note: 0-based indices into the device's channel list. NOT confirmed. M0 confirms them by sending a tone to one output at a time and observing where it lands. Do not trust these until measured_at is set.
host._latency_note: Measured electrically by patching an output back to an input. Sets the spacing of the phase-condition comb.

xruns_in_60s_at_block._note: 60.00 s at 48 kHz / 128 frames, clean. Re-run after any change to block size or latency hint.

host._focusrite_note: Must read 'Playback 3/4' only. A hardware mix carrying Input 1 to outputs 3/4 closes an analog loop the DSP cannot see or mute.
host._latency_hint_note: sounddevice defaults to 'high', which asked this interface for ~90 ms of buffering per direction. Measured 88.6 in / 91.0 out on the default, 11.3 in / 13.7 out with 'low', both with zero xruns. Never open a stream on the default.

portaudio_reported_latency_ms._note: PortAudio's configured buffering, NOT a measurement. The real number is the electrical loopback in round_trip_latency_ms, still unmeasured.

callback_headroom._note: Worst case is about 2 percent of the block deadline. Python is not the bottleneck.

gain_staging._target: about -12 dBFS peak on normal playing, so feedback growth has room before clipping
gain_staging._ceiling_note: A safety constant in code. No tuning process may raise it. Recorded here for the log only; code is the authority.
gain_staging._amp_note: Fixed constant once set. Never a variable under test.

safety._kill_note: Either the volume pedal patched between Scarlett out 3/4 and the amp (recommended), or the amp's own volume control within arm's reach. The Scarlett monitor knob is NOT a kill for outputs 3/4. Must be filled in before any live-loop run.

loop._unity_note: The software master gain at which the loop first reaches unity, with the amp at its fixed setting. This is the M1 headline measurement.
loop._candidates_note: Ranked jump-destination list. On this rig it comes from the M1 baseline takes rather than a swept sine, until a sweep is worth the time.

control._control_note: No analog input on this rig. Regulation depth is a MIDI CC or a keyboard key until the Bela returns. Same axis as the expression pedal, different transducer.

baseline._note: The 'before' recordings: the loop feeding back with no regulation, at several master-gain positions. Every later result is compared against these.

bela_parked._note: Kept for when the board is connectable again. See docs/phase-plan.md.

expression_pedal._note: adc_heel/adc_toe are raw 0-1 analogRead values. A 3.3 V-fed pedal tops out near 0.806, not 1.0. Never hard-code the range.
